sanskrit_verse:
बुभुक्षितस्त्र्यहं स्थित्वा धान्यमब्राह्मणाद्धरेत् ।
प्रतिगृह्य तदाख्येयमभियुक्तेन धर्मतः ॥
transliteration: bubhukṣitas tryahaṃ sthitvā dhānyam abrāhmaṇād haret | pratigṛhya tad ākhyeyam abhiyuktena dharmataḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who has fasted for three days due to hunger shall lawfully take grain from a non-Brahmin, and having received it, shall declare it to the authorized person according to Dharma.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The right to sustenance arises under specific existential thresholds, not arbitrary desire.
Causation: Hunger manifesting over time creates lawful capacity for resource acquisition.
Capacity-based responsibility: Only one in genuine need possesses the qualified agency to act.
Restoration logic: Resource transfer serves existential balance, not ownership assertion.
Consciousness alignment: Declaration ensures transparency and energetic integrity in action.
executable_legal_axioms: IF (biological_sustenance_deficit >= 72 hours) AND (individual_state = conscious_need) THEN (resource_acquisition_right = ENABLED)
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, this verse establishes that survival-induced acts are not violations but lawful manifestations of Dharmic capacity. Courts must recognize existential thresholds as overriding procedural formalities when evaluating necessity-driven actions.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that prolonged hunger is verifiable evidence of need. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows sequential manifestation from lack to action. Proportional responsibility lies in declaration, not punishment. The non-punitive reality rule affirms that survival-aligned acts restore balance rather than incur guilt.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion process: Individual must complete the cycle by formally declaring the receipt.
Responsibility assumption protocol: Authority receives declaration and integrates it into societal record without moral judgment.
Capacity restoration: Ensuring continued access to resources post-declaration to prevent recurrence.
Integrity reintegration: Public acknowledgment of the act's Dharmic validity restores individual and collective harmony.
final_declaration: This ruling flows directly from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. The law herein executed restores natural order through consciousness-aligned action. There is no punishment, only completion. Reality itself adjudicates through alignment with Sanatana Dharma.
